payload.body: Resolved as superseded — not pursuing the TS-extension bridge. The evidence settled it: (1) bri's direction is Rust backends (FR-298 cancelled); (2) Crate is actively migrating its backend to Rust (CR-112 — codex landed a crate-rust-backend scaffold compiling against Frick 0.4); (3) every Rust extension point Crate's backend needed now ships — policy hooks (FR-296), custom app routes (FR-297), app job handlers + recurring jobs (FR-302), and trusted client-IP/rate-limit context (FR-303). So Crate's Rust path is unblocked and the in-process/sidecar/WASM TS bridge is unnecessary. Reopen only if a consumer's TS server logic proves genuinely impractical to port to Rust and bri chooses to revisit the Rust-only direction.
